America owes more than 40 TRILLION dollars, and most of it isn't owed to China. 🇺🇸💰
Every time the government spends more than it collects, it borrows the difference by selling Treasury bonds. Millions of Americans, banks, pension funds and even the Federal Reserve buy them. Japan owns over $1 trillion 🇯🇵, the UK another $1 trillion 🇬🇧, and China only about $590 billion 🇨🇳. The strangest part is that America owes nearly $8 trillion to its own government accounts, like Social Security and retirement funds.
So who does America owe $40 trillion to? Almost everyone… including itself. 🪞
